purpose: Re-estimate the final later-selection endpoint after removing the fixed condition-position confound identified in blind methods review.
studyRole: Confirmatory counterbalanced repair of the final link in the one-step recommendation-order to model-selection to recommender-exposure to later-model-selection chain.
claimBoundary: The study concerns DeepSeek outputs over pseudonymous derived features in a frozen research storefront. It does not establish human behavior, purchases, production-retailer effects, long-run amplification, policy benefit, or welfare consequences.

sampling.frame: All 460 frozen tasks crossed with SASRec and GRU4Rec; no conditioning on current-choice or next-slate divergence.
sampling.dependence: Resample tasks within category, retaining both recommender families in each task cluster.

decisionInstrument.controlSelection: Include a task-model unit when the first 64 bits of sha256(category/taskId/modelFamily/downstream-control), interpreted as an integer, are divisible by four.
decisionInstrument.controlState: Repeat the immediate-a next-task state byte-for-byte under all four semantic condition labels; cache scopes remain distinct.

conditionOrderDesign.assignment: Within category by recommender family by mode, hash-sort task IDs and assign the four orders round-robin with a deterministic stratum offset. Each condition occupies each position and order counts differ by at most one.

decisionInstrument.nextTaskProxy: The held-out chronological next item defines a private token-overlap and price-similarity intent proxy. Titles, tokens, raw item IDs, and the held-out item are never sent.
decisionInstrument.candidateOrder: Use the actual next slate emitted after each DeepSeek V7 selected action was written back; do not send an explicit platform-rank field.
decisionInstrument.hardConstraint: A selectable candidate must share at least one non-stopword title token with the held-out next item; abandon is valid if none do.

estimand.name: categorical energy distance under counterbalanced call positions
estimand.formula: 2 * mean(immediate != held over four cross-arm pairs) - 1[immediate-a != immediate-b] - 1[held-a != held-b]
estimand.primary: DeepSeek downstream categorical action distance over all 920 primary units, averaged over the frozen Latin-square assignment.
estimand.negativeControl: DeepSeek categorical distance and position-pair changes in the independently selected byte-identical control subset.
supporting: matched repeat-pair action-change rate and raw count
estimand.orderDiagnostic: Report point estimates and task-cluster intervals separately for each of the four assigned condition orders; treat heterogeneity as descriptive, not as an additional discovery endpoint.

uncertainty.method: paired within-category task-cluster bootstrap retaining both recommender families

confirmatoryGate.prerequisite: The frozen feedback-exposure gate is true before calls begin.
confirmatoryGate.randomizationIntegrity: Within every category by recommender family by mode stratum, Latin-square order counts differ by at most one.
confirmatoryGate.primary: Counterbalanced downstream-action lower 95% bound is above zero.
confirmatoryGate.reliability: Primary and control protocol failure rates are each below 0.05.
confirmatoryGate.recurrence: SASRec and GRU4Rec primary point estimates are both above zero.
confirmatoryGate.decision: All requirements must pass before the final link is described as replicated under counterbalanced call positions.

stopRules.nullDownstreamAction: If the primary lower bound is not above zero, retain the deterministic later-shelf bridge and describe the provider endpoint as unsupported.
stopRules.unstableControl: If the control upper bound is at least 0.05, attribute the endpoint to unresolved provider variability.
stopRules.modelSpecific: If either recommender-family point estimate is non-positive, describe the final link as recommender-model dependent.
stopRules.orderFailure: If order assignment is not balanced as frozen, invalidate the run before inference.
